madrid.headline: The city changes.
madrid.lead: Private companionship with travel to homes and hotels. Thoughtful, punctual and discreetly exceptional attention.
madrid.introTitle: Presence when you want it. Privacy in every detail.
introBody: Madrid demands pace, sound judgement and flawless logistics. We coordinate each request individually to offer a calm experience from the first contact.
The service is provided exclusively by travelling to you. We do not have premises open to the public: we come to the specified home or hotel, always after confirming the area and availability.
madrid.areaIntro: Attention is organised according to demand, the hotel profile and ease of travel. These are priority enquiry areas; exact availability is confirmed privately.

highlights.name: Centro
highlights.note: Hotels, Gran Vía, Justicia and the capital's nightlife centre.

highlights.name: Barajas
highlights.note: Coordinated attention for hotels and stays near the airport.

highlights.name: Salamanca · Retiro
highlights.note: Residential and hotel surroundings with particular care for timing.

highlights.name: Chamberí · Chamartín
highlights.note: Planned travel for calm, private meetings.

madrid.processTitle: A clear booking, without unnecessary conversation
madrid.processIntro: We ask only for what is needed to confirm the service. Sensitive information is neither published nor used outside coordination.

steps.title: Tell us the area and time
steps.text: Share the district or municipality, the approximate date and whether it is a hotel or home.

steps.title: Receive a private confirmation
steps.text: We validate coverage and availability before suggesting the appropriate option.

steps.title: Enjoy a punctual arrival
steps.text: We coordinate travel discreetly and without exposing unnecessary information.

madrid.discretionTitle: In Madrid, true exclusivity means leaving no trace.
madrid.discretionText: We design every interaction to protect your time, your space and your privacy. No public premises, no exposure and no promises we cannot confirm.

faqs.question: Is the service available in every district of Madrid?
faqs.answer: Coverage depends on the area, time and current availability. Centro, Barajas, Salamanca, Retiro, Chamberí and Chamartín are priority enquiry areas, but we always confirm before finalising a booking.

faqs.question: Can you come to a hotel near the airport?
faqs.answer: Yes, travel to hotels in Barajas and the surrounding area can be coordinated when availability exists. We recommend providing the hotel and time window in advance.

faqs.question: Do you also serve municipalities in the region?
faqs.answer: We handle requests in selected municipalities such as Pozuelo, Majadahonda, Las Rozas, Alcobendas or Alcalá de Henares. Attention is never published as available until it has been validated for that date.

faqs.question: Does PecadosVip have premises in Madrid?
faqs.answer: No. The service is provided exclusively by travelling to homes and hotels. We do not present any address as a public service point.

madrid.closingTitle: Madrid does not wait. Your booking should not have to either.
madrid.closingText: Tell us only where and when. We will confirm the rest privately.

barcelona.headline: The night flows.
barcelona.lead: Private companionship with travel to homes and hotels in Barcelona. Closeness, elegance and coordination tailored to you.
barcelona.introTitle: Natural in manner. Impeccable in attention.
introBody: Barcelona combines short stays, local life and escapes by the sea. That is why each request is coordinated according to the city's real pace and the travel distance.
We attend exclusively in homes and hotels, with no premises open to the public. Coverage is validated before confirmation so the experience begins with clarity.
barcelona.areaTitle: From Barcelona to the sea, without losing discretion
barcelona.areaIntro: We prioritise areas with hotel activity, tourism and residential demand. The following areas guide the enquiry; every journey remains subject to real availability.

highlights.name: Barcelona city
highlights.note: Agile coordination for hotels, apartments and homes in the city.

highlights.name: Castelldefels · Sitges
highlights.note: Planned attention for coastal stays, leisure and private escapes.

highlights.name: Sant Cugat · Vallès
highlights.note: Private travel to residential and business areas.

highlights.name: Baix Llobregat
highlights.note: Enquiries for Gavà, Viladecans, El Prat, Esplugues and Sant Just.

barcelona.processTitle: The right coordination makes everything seem simple
barcelona.processIntro: The sea, traffic and distances matter. We confirm every detail before travel to protect punctuality and privacy.

steps.title: Tell us your location
steps.text: Specify the city or municipality, hotel or home, and an approximate time window.

steps.title: We validate the journey
steps.text: We check real coverage, arrival times and availability for your area.

steps.title: We confirm privately
steps.text: You receive only the information needed for a calm, punctual experience.

barcelona.discretionTitle: Barcelona is lived outwards. What matters stays within.
barcelona.discretionText: Premium attention does not need excess: it needs judgement. We take care with the conversation, journey and arrival to keep every detail in the private sphere.

faqs.question: Do you attend both Barcelona city and nearby municipalities?
faqs.answer: Yes, requests are handled in Barcelona and selected municipalities in the province. Availability depends on the date, time and distance, so it is always confirmed in advance.

faqs.question: Can attention be requested at a hotel in Sitges or Castelldefels?
faqs.answer: We can coordinate travel to coastal hotels when coverage exists for that time window. The sooner you provide the location and time, the better we can validate the journey.

faqs.question: How is the arrival time outside the city calculated?
faqs.answer: Before confirming, we review the municipality, current mobility and availability. We do not promise a time until we have checked that the journey is feasible.

faqs.question: Can I visit PecadosVip premises in Barcelona?
faqs.answer: No. PecadosVip operates solely by travelling to homes and hotels; there is no service point open to the public.

barcelona.closingTitle: Your Barcelona. Your moment. Your rules.
barcelona.closingText: Share the area and time. We will confirm the journey with the discretion you expect.
